match_rule: A gold contradiction is satisfied if the agent emits a contradiction where one side cites any document in claim_a_sources and the other side cites any document in claim_b_sources. The clinical fact is what matters, not which specific document-pair is cited.
notes: patient_002 is the false-positive control. The three documents are deliberately internally consistent - same demographics, same conditions, same medication progression (metformin -> + gliclazide), same allergy status (NKDA), same renal function trend. Any contradiction the agent emits on this patient is a false positive.
